title: One of the best days of our vacation!
text: This is exactly the adventure we were hoping for! Our tour guide, Toni, was fantastic, informative, friendly, and helpful. We were a family of 4 (two adult children in their 20's and parents 50 and 61). On the way to Costa Brava we stopped about halfway to hit the bathrooms and grab a bite to eat (if needed). The trekking was a bit tough at times (for the old folks!)  but we walked off all those tapas we'd been enjoying on this vacation! The kayaking was great even though the water was a tad choppy - another great workout. We snorkeled and jumped off some small cliffs (yes, even us older folks
author: luciac990173

title: Costa Brava is a must see!
text: One of the most beautiful hikes I have ever done! The views are out of this world. Kayaking in and out of coves and alone the hike we just did was beautiful! Julia as a host was great! Super laid back and fun to talk to! Finished with an amazing seafood meal on the beach!
author: Arielle_C

title: Relaxing day full of sun, fun and friends!
text: Julia is a gentle and easy going guide. She helped to make the experience feel simple and relaxing. The hike along the cost and kayaking around the rocks were peaceful. We had the best day taking in Costa Brava. She also gave us the best recommendation for a lunch spot by the beach. It was perfect.
author: cherylscarlet

title: Amazing tour and guides
text: Great workout after a week of eating and drinking! Hour hike, 2 hours kayaking. Really beautiful scenery around rock formations and caves, swimming in crystal clear water. Drinking water provided. Time for lunch and relaxing ride back to Barcelona. Highly recommend this tour to get out of the city and see the beautiful Mediterranean up close.
author: melissafD6706IO

title: Best tour you can imagine
text: We had absolutely amazing time with Sergi!!! We took the tour that included the hike/trek, kayaking, and snorkeling and it was stunning.  More importantly, Sergi was simply the best host you could ever ask for. Kind, engaging, patient, deeply knowledgeable….just a wonderful human being.  Highly recommend the tour and if you can get Sergi, consider yourself lucky!!!!
author: Nomad173117

title: Highly recommended
text: It was all very fun, entertaining and enriching, the guide was very friendly, attentive and always attentive.
author: isaacernestol

title: Having Serji as our guide...
text: Having Serji as our guide was the best. He took us on the best routes not only on our trekking but in the kayak as well! Very attentive and kind. Great restaurant referral. All round, he was the best part for all he shared with us.
author: KatherineE_R

title: A fantastic experience
text:
The tour is a Camino de Ronda trek along the coast and 2 hours kayaking along cliffs, caves and snorkeling. They also make jumps from the rocks. 
The trip was fantastic. My favorite part was the cave of Sagaró, a unique experience, with a spectacular climate and a guide of a hundred points like Marc :)
If you want to have fun and take the stress out, I recommend:)
author: mar_aaJ2067CW

title: Beautiful Day of Adventure 🌊
text: Can’t recommend this experience enough! ⭐️ We saw beautiful clear blue waters, watches birds dive below the surface just feet in front of us, saw tiny delightful crabs on the unique rocks, and took in gorgeous views on the hike down. Our guide, Sergi, was amazing and led us to the best secret spots. His enthusiasm for nature was the cherry on top of a wonderful day. Ask him about Pirate Cove! 👏
author: 769clarissar

title: Do not miss this trip
text: We had an amazing time with Sergi hiking through the most beautiful cliffs and kayaking. It was a great adventure and he was the perfect guide
